svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The attention score matrix grows with the square of the length
svg.desc: Square grids for sequence lengths 4, 8 and 16 show that doubling the length quadruples the number of attention scores. In FP16 one head's matrix is 8 MiB at 2048 tokens, 32 MiB at 4096 and 128 MiB at 8192.
svg.text: Every token scores every other token: N × N entries per head
Multiply by heads and batch size. This stored matrix is the memory blow-up that FlashAttention avoids.
